thread:
Maria (CSM): Hi team :wave: Kicking off onboarding for Aegis Analytics. Quick overview: they're a fintech analytics startup, will start with embeddings+semantic search and a chat assistant. Key stakeholders: Peter (Head of Data), Rina (Platform), and Samir (PM). Success criteria: 1) Search latency < 120ms on prototype, 2) semantic recall >= 85% on our eval prompts, 3) internal demo by 6/28. Timeline: kickoff this week, pilot deploy by 7/10, production-ready by 8/15. Primary risks: SSO + data access, and volume spikes during batch reindex. Proposed kickoff meeting: Thu 6/29 10am PT. Can everyone confirm availability? Also need eng lead + enablement slots. Attach: onboarding checklist link: https://redwood.internal/onboard-checklist/aegis

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can take eng lead. :+1: Thu 6/29 10am PT works for me. Quick Q on data: expected corpus size? Will they share sample CSV/Parquet or is it a streaming pipeline?

Maria (CSM): Thanks Sam — I'll introduce Peter/Rina in the calendar invite. Per contract they plan to ingest ~250k docs initially (mostly JSONL), with nightly incremental loads. There is a streaming hook later but pilot is bulk. I'll DM the sample data.

Lee (Product): Noted success criteria. For the recall metric, do we have their eval set or should we reuse our default semantic-eval harness? If they have domain-specific queries we should run them.

Anita (Enablement): I can run two enablement sessions: one for admin setup (SSO, org roles) and one for prompt engineering. Suggested dates: 7/2 and 7/9, 60m each. Need list of attendees and SSO metadata (IdP type).

Jordan (AE): Heads-up: contract renewal window opens 2 months after production go-live. If pilot drags, we'll need an extension clause. Also confirm whether Dedicated capacity is on roadmap — that impacts pricing and onboarding priority.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Re: data size — 250k JSONL is doable. For initial ingest we'll recommend gzip-compressed batches and a single reindex job. Will set up a staging bucket and share S3 credentials pattern. Also flagging potential need for vector quantization settings if memory becomes tight.

Maria (CSM): Action items:
- Maria -> send calendar invite + intro to Peter/Rina (today)
- Sam -> provision staging bucket + upload instructions (by 6/30)
- Anita -> schedule enablement invites for 7/2 and 7/9, share slide deck (by 6/30)
- Lee -> draft eval harness + list of metrics we'll run (by 7/3)
- Jordan -> confirm Dedicated vs Hosted preference with customer and share pricing note (by 7/5)
Please add anything I missed. :memo:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Aegis Analytics — Onboarding Kickoff" Thu 2024-06-29 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maria (CSM), Sam (Solutions Eng), Jordan (AE), Lee (Product), Anita (Enablement), Peter (Aegis), Rina (Aegis), Samir (Aegis).

Lee (Product): I'll pair with Sam on the eval harness. One more ask: can we get two sample queries that represent worst-case retrieval? If Aegis can provide, we can tune similarity thresholds before pilot.

Maria (CSM): Good call. I'll ask Peter for 2 worst-case queries and a short list of security contacts for SSO. Thanks everyone — let's aim to close the staging setup by Monday so we can start ingesting.

Sam (Solutions Eng): On it. I'll post the staging bucket template here once ready. Expecting to share IAM pattern + sample CLI commands.

Anita (Enablement): Added the training invitees. Will post the slide deck in #docs channel and share recording link after the sessions.

Jordan (AE): I chatted with the buyer — they're leaning Hosted for pilot but want Dedicated for production if latency and cost look good. I'll confirm formally by EOD Friday.

Maria (CSM): Perfect. I'll follow up after the kickoff with a combined timeline and risk register. :white_check_mark: End of thread.
